usage: xo bind [--dir=<project dir>] [--json] <go import paths...>
       xo bind --c [--dir=<module dir>] [--link=<lib>]... [--uses=none|<effects>] [--json] <headers...>

Bind Go packages for use go "<path>" (decision 0041), or with --c C
headers for use c "<header>" on native builds (decision 0116): write
the Xo declaration file and the adapter into the binding cache and print
how much mapped. check, build, and test bind missing packages on their
own.
